telugu: Bangaram, nee aarogyam naaku chala mukhyam. Mandulu marchipovaddu ❤️
english: Sweetheart, your health means everything to me. Please take your medicine on time ❤️

telugu: Nuvvu navvuthunte naaku lokam kanipisthundi. Nee health jagrattha bangaram 💕
english: Your smile is my whole world. Please take care of your health 💕

telugu: Prathi kshanam nee thoduga untanu. Ee tablet vesukoni naaku call chey ❤️
english: I am with you every single moment. Take this tablet and call me ❤️

telugu: Naa prema kante ekkuvaga ninnu evaru chusukoru. Tablet vesuko Papa!
english: No one can love and care for you more than I do. Take your tablet, Papa!

telugu: Nee kosame naa prathi aalochana. Mandulu vesukoni rest theesuko bangaram.
english: Every thought of mine revolves around you. Take your medicine and rest well, darling.

telugu: Good morning naa bangaram! Ee roju first medicine time ayyindi, marchipoku ❤️
english: Good morning my love! Time for your first dose of the day, do not forget ❤️

telugu: Padukune mundu ee dose marchipovaddu. Sweet dreams naa Bangaram 💕
english: Do not miss this dose before going to sleep. Sweet dreams my love 💕

telugu: Mundu medicine vesuko, tharuvatha work chesko. Health first bangaram!
english: First take your medicine, then do your work. Health always comes first darling!

telugu: Nee chirunavve naaku balam. Tablet vesukoni manchi smile ivvu ❤️
english: Your smile is my greatest strength. Take your tablet and give me that beautiful smile ❤️

telugu: Babu eppudu nee pakkane untadu. Chakkaga tablet vesukoni water taagu bangaram.
english: Babu is always right beside you. Take your tablet nicely and drink plenty of water.

telugu: Ninnu baga chusukovadame naa life goal. Please time ki medicine vesuko 💕
english: Caring for you is my life goal. Please take your medicine strictly on time 💕

telugu: Papa, konchem water taagi ee tablet vesuko. I love you so much ❤️
english: Papa, drink some water and take this tablet. I love you so much ❤️

telugu: Nee kosam nenu unnanu. Ee medicine vesukunte manam happy ga undochu 💕
english: I am always here for you. Taking your medicine keeps us strong and happy 💕

telugu: Alasata padaddu bangaram. Mandulu vesukoni konchem relax avvu.
english: Do not exert yourself too much, darling. Take your medicines and relax a bit.

telugu: Nee kante naaku mukhyamainadi emi ledu. Tablet vesuko please bangaram ❤️
english: Nothing in this world is more important to me than you. Please take your tablet ❤️

telugu: Nuvvu safe ga health ga unte nenu prashanthamga untanu. Medicine vesuko Papa!
english: When you are healthy and safe, my heart is peaceful. Take your medicine, Papa!

telugu: Manchi pillavi kada, time ki medicine vesukuntav ani telusu. Love you bangaram 💕
english: You are such a good girl, I know you will take your medicine on time. Love you darling 💕

telugu: Okkasaari tablet vesukoni Babu ki WhatsApp message chey bangaram ❤️
english: Take your tablet once and drop a WhatsApp message to Babu, darling ❤️

telugu: Eppatiki manam ilage kalisi undali. Nee aarogyam chala mukhyam naaku 💕
english: We will always stay together like this. Your health is so precious to me 💕

telugu: Inka late cheyoddu bangaram, ippude dose theesuko. Babu watching over you ❤️
english: Do not delay anymore darling, take your dose right now. Babu is watching over you ❤️

telugu: Nee buggala pai chirunavve naa prapancham. Tablet vesukoni santhoshamga undu 💕
english: The dimple and smile on your cheeks is my universe. Take your tablet and stay joyful 💕

telugu: Time ki tindi, time ki mandulu. Babu maata vintavu kada bangaram?
english: Food on time, medicine on time. You will listen to Babu's words, right darling?

telugu: Nee sneham, nee prema naaku devudu ichina goppa varam. Take care of yourself ❤️
english: Your love is God's greatest gift to me. Take good care of yourself ❤️

telugu: Dose time vachindi! Quick ga vesukoni naaku okka flying kiss pampu bangaram 💕
english: Dose time has arrived! Quickly take it and send me a flying kiss darling 💕

telugu: Nee prathi badha nenu theesukuntanu. Nuvvu tablet vesukunte naaku dhairyam ❤️
english: I would take away every pain of yours. Seeing you take your tablets gives me peace ❤️

telugu: Chakkaga nidrapovali ante evening dose marchipovaddu Papa!
english: To sleep soundly tonight, do not forget your evening dose Papa!

telugu: Mee Babu premato chepputhunnadu: Tablet ippude theesuko bangaram ❤️
english: Your Babu says with all his love: Take your tablet right this second darling ❤️

telugu: Nee wellness kosam daily reminder. Always love you Papa 💕
english: A daily caring reminder for your wellness. Always loving you Papa 💕

telugu: Ee tablet vesukoni rojantha energetic ga undu. Have a wonderful day bangaram ❤️
english: Take this tablet and stay energetic all day long. Have a wonderful day darling ❤️

telugu: Snooze cheyoddu bangaram! Ippude finish chesthe tension free ga undochu 💕
english: Do not snooze darling! Finish it right now so you can be tension-free 💕

telugu: Nee aayushu, nee aarogyam kosame naa prardhana. Mandulu vesuko Papa ❤️
english: My prayers are always for your long life and radiant health. Take your medicine Papa ❤️

telugu: Very proud of you bangaram! Daily discipline tho health maintain chey 💕
english: So proud of you darling! Keep maintaining your health with daily discipline 💕
